responseText: {"title":"The Face as Field","question":"How many different kinds of pressure can a single face hold before it stops being a face?","introduction":"Twenty-four works line these walls, each built around a head. Some hold their outlines firmly; others let interior marks overwhelm structure until the face becomes a field of competing forces. Moving through the gallery, watch what happens when color, line, ground, and gesture all press inward at once — and what, if anything, remains recognizable at the end.","closing":"The question the gallery opened with has no clean answer here. Each work tests a different threshold, and the line between face and field keeps moving.","chapters":[{"title":"Structure Still Holds","introduction":"Four heads where a readable outline and distinct features remain, even as layered marks begin to crowd the surface. The face is present, but already under pressure.","stops":[{"slot":"W010","whyHere":"The white ground and heavy glasses give this head a clear armature; colored lines cross it repeatedly without yet dissolving its structure.","transitionFromPrevious":null},{"slot":"W007","whyHere":"The thick black outline pushes the head close to the frame; layered eye loops and exposed teeth add density while the grey ground keeps each hue distinct.","transitionFromPrevious":"Where W010 has open white space around it, this head fills the canvas edge to edge, tightening the pressure immediately."},{"slot":"W005","whyHere":"A white sticker-border contains the face against flat purple; clashing warm and cool zones inside push outward while the boundary holds them posted rather than embedded.","transitionFromPrevious":"The grey ground of the previous work gave way to saturated purple — a flat, even field that keeps the face's internal heat contained rather than released."},{"slot":"W003","whyHere":"A thick white outline cuts the head from its scribbled black surround; interior lines in clashing colors sit on top of each other without blending, making the face feel compressed.","transitionFromPrevious":"The purple field of the previous work is replaced by dense black scrawl filling every corner, so the surrounding field becomes as agitated as the face itself."}]},{"title":"The Split Face and the Mismatched Eye","introduction":"Works where the face divides — left against right, one eye refusing to match the other — so that internal contrast becomes the subject rather than a side effect.","stops":[{"slot":"W017","whyHere":"The face splits down the middle: dense red marks on one side, open yellow on the other, both held by a single white outline and a mouth packed with vertical white teeth.","transitionFromPrevious":"The compressed interior of the previous work here becomes an explicit division — the face literally halved, each side governed by a different visual logic."},{"slot":"W034","whyHere":"Two eyes that refuse to match — one a warm target of nested rings, the other a cold spoked wheel — while comb marks above and below enforce a grim symmetry.","transitionFromPrevious":"Where the previous work splits the face vertically, this one splits it through the eyes alone, the rest of the composition holding a tense, sealed symmetry around that mismatch."},{"slot":"W014","whyHere":"Blue petals and a coiled ring sit where matching eyes should be; a neat grid of white blocks spans the lower face, reading almost decorative against the surrounding tangle.","transitionFromPrevious":"The amber ground of the previous work gives way to dark olive-green; the eye mismatch is softer here but the face remains watchful and resistant to easy reading."},{"slot":"W037","whyHere":"Two rectangular eye shapes, each filled with spiraling lines, read as simultaneously hollow and agitated; scattered lines at the edges feel like pressure the central form cannot contain.","transitionFromPrevious":"The dark olive ground shifts to yellow-green, pushing the central form forward with blunt force rather than holding it in shadow."}]},{"title":"Ground as Pressure","introduction":"Works where the background is not neutral — radiating slashes, dense hatching, saturated fields — so the face is squeezed from outside as well as marked from within.","stops":[{"slot":"W026","whyHere":"Radiating yellow slashes give the orange field an outward pressure while looping teal lines pull inward; the face pushes to every edge, leaving no neutral space.","transitionFromPrevious":"The yellow-green ground of the previous work becomes orange, and the background itself now radiates outward, reversing the direction of pressure."},{"slot":"W013","whyHere":"Dense overlapping strokes press against a completely still flat red field; the glasses fix one point inside the noise while a thick yellow bar cuts the right edge mid-scene.","transitionFromPrevious":"The radiating ground of the previous work is replaced by a flat, motionless red — the contrast between active face and inert field is now at its sharpest."},{"slot":"W021","whyHere":"Amber fills every edge, pressing the face forward; eye sockets buried under coiled black lines feel closed or guarded, the face both present and resistant to being seen.","transitionFromPrevious":"The flat red field becomes warm amber, and the face loses the glasses that anchored the previous work — the fixed point dissolves into layered coils."},{"slot":"W001","whyHere":"Saturated yellow holds the dark central mass and scattered scribbles at the same visual distance; a cool green glow at the midsection pulls attention inward against the warm field.","transitionFromPrevious":"The amber ground brightens to saturated yellow; the face-form loses clear features and becomes a dark mass competing with scattered marks across the field."},{"slot":"W012","whyHere":"A pale gold form arches back into blackness while a grid pressed into the hot orange field reads as confinement; scribbled lines pile at the base like static.","transitionFromPrevious":"The yellow ground of the previous work splits into a black void behind the form and a hot orange field around it — the face caught between two opposing temperatures."}]},{"title":"Figures Under Accumulation","introduction":"Heads that carry hats, hands, lettering, or companion forms — where the face shares the image with other elements that add weight, gesture, or a second focal pull.","stops":[{"slot":"W043","whyHere":"A weighted cap dominates the upper half while the face beneath dissolves into white scribble and red stripe; a raised finger beside the head adds a blunt outward gesture.","transitionFromPrevious":"After the faceless arching form of the previous work, a recognizable figure re-emerges — but the cap presses down while the face beneath it loses coherence."},{"slot":"W006","whyHere":"Arms flung wide frame the face with thin scratchy strokes; the dark hat presses down while the open mouth and spread fingers set two opposing forces against each other.","transitionFromPrevious":"The single raised finger of the previous work expands here into both arms thrown outward, the body now fully part of the composition's pressure."},{"slot":"W019","whyHere":"The head pushes to all four edges of a flat pink field; a crossed-line eye reads as a target while the open-toothed mouth holds shout and snarl simultaneously.","transitionFromPrevious":"The teal field and hat of the previous work give way to flat pink; the figure loses its arms but gains a more confrontational frontality."},{"slot":"W042","whyHere":"A dark rounded form buried under layered scribble holds a yellow X eye and a red mouth zone; scattered ovals in the upper corner keep the mood unsettled rather than resolved.","transitionFromPrevious":"The pink ground and bold outlines of the previous work are replaced by a yellow-green field and dense gray-blue scribble that buries the face's features under accumulated marks."},{"slot":"W045","whyHere":"Horizontal black bands ring the skull-like form while heart outlines at the lower edge pull against the harder geometry above, giving the image a divided emotional register.","transitionFromPrevious":"The yellow-green field shifts to salmon-pink banded with black; the skull form is softer but the horizontal pressure from outside the face intensifies."},{"slot":"W011","whyHere":"Red fills every corner, pressing the central black-green form forward; white outlines loop without settling into features, holding unease and absurdity at the same time.","transitionFromPrevious":"The banded pink ground becomes saturated red, and the face loses its hat and accessories — only the looping outlines remain, suggesting features without confirming them."}]},{"title":"Multiplication and Dissolution","introduction":"Works where the face multiplies into several forms, or where accumulated line overwhelms any single readable head. The question of where the face ends becomes unanswerable.","stops":[{"slot":"W029","whyHere":"Concentric gold arcs draw the eye inward while a yellow bar cuts across and a dense black-and-white row stops that pull abruptly; the face is implied by structure alone.","transitionFromPrevious":"The saturated red of the previous work gives way to cool blue; the face retreats into geometric arcs and a mechanical X-marked circle, barely a face at all."},{"slot":"W023","whyHere":"A yellow field and hard red stripe divide the image into horizontal zones; paired spirals sit as fixed points while zigzag rows pulse with a mechanical, repetitive rhythm.","transitionFromPrevious":"The cool blue field becomes yellow and red in hard horizontal bands; the face is now a pair of spirals inside an architectural structure rather than a single head."},{"slot":"W015","whyHere":"A large striped head and a cluster of five smaller skull forms set up a size contrast; the pink claws and orange X inside the large head read as markers rather than features.","transitionFromPrevious":"The paired spirals of the previous work multiply further here into five smaller skull forms clustered beside a dominant striped head — the face becomes a repeating unit."},{"slot":"W028","whyHere":"Two large skull forms face outward from a black ground, their outlines drawn in looping lines that leave gaps; yellow angles press upward between them while layered scribbles read as noise.","transitionFromPrevious":"The horizontal banding of the previous work gives way to a near-black ground; the skull forms are now paired and confrontational, their outlines deliberately incomplete."},{"slot":"W024","whyHere":"Two open-mouthed forms with visible tooth rows compete with marks in every direction; a red heart in the lower right offers a quieter note without settling the surrounding conflict.","transitionFromPrevious":"The two skull forms of the previous work become two snarling open mouths in a grey-brown field crowded with competing marks — the face has nearly dissolved into accumulated line."}]}]}
